channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Terence Davis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Terence Davis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Matt Thomas, Terence Davis
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Nick Nurse on Thomas & Davis:

“They've made way too many mistakes defensively. They're our two best shooters probably but they're just coming out and fouling and giving up boatloads of pointsin a short amount of minutes, and they can't get that many back on the other end.”

Nick Nurse on Matt Thomas, Terence Davis, Jan 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.

item.title: Fred VanVleet on Terence Davis
item.description:
Blake Murphy:VanVleet on Davis not being in Rising Stars:

“None of us have ever played in it, so what difference does it make? Welcome to the party.”

Fred VanVleet on Terence Davis, Feb 2, 2020. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Terence Davis
item.description:
Josh Lewenberg:Nurse on Terence Davis' career-high 31 points:

“I always think about the games where I play him 6 minutes and wonder what the hell I'm doing when he's playing like that.”

Nick Nurse on Terence Davis, Feb 2, 2020. Source: Twitter @JLew1050.
